thread:
sam_cs: FYI renewal for HelixPay due next month. Customer asking to shorten to 6mo instead of annual to align procurement cycles. Doc: https://docsend.com/helixpay-renewal-draft

emily_legal: short term ok but need exec sig for pricing waiver. Who's owner for signoff?

lee_sales: I'm the AE but ask finance for CC approval first. risk: we lose discount.

jordan_am: @chris_finance can you confirm whether CC approval is allowed? If not PO will be required.

chris_finance: Can accept CC up to $50k. This renewal is $72k. PO required or need manager approval. cc: require waiver form.

anita_ops: Onboarding schedule note — if we get signoff by 3/20 we can do enablement week of 4/1. Otherwise delay by 3 weeks.

sam_cs: procurement asked for vendor code and KMS attestation. They want PO line: `PO: PO-7789-HELIX` and vendor code `VC-3491`. Can legal pre-approve KMS language?

emily_legal: share the minimal clause, I'll pre-approve. paste below.

emily_legal: ```
KMS: Customer-managed key option requires 30-day lead time, signed addendum.
```

lee_sales: I'll push for PO today. @procurement_bot can you confirm vendor code mapping?

procurement_bot: Vendor code VC-3491 mapped to Helix Inc. — requires tax form W-9 or EU VAT.

chris_finance: if they can do split payment (part CC, part PO) we can process faster. Proposed: $35k CC + $37k PO. Need approval from @cfo.

sam_cs: I'll propose split and ask customer. Also capturing feedback: they flagged onboarding timing as main blocker.

jordan_am: +1 collect training seats list. @anita_ops can you prep 2x 90-min sessions and a short checklist for them?

anita_ops: will prepare slides + checklist, share by EOD Thursday.

lee_sales: thanks team — looping in exec sponsor. Will update thread with PO or exec sign by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup: 

sam_cs: noted, marking risk as 'Procurement delay' in renewal tracker. Thanks everyone.
